research: [spread] Washington has covered in just 1 of 5 games this season (SI Betting, Oct 5 2026). Helps Iowa +3.

[spread] The line drifted toward Washington: DraftKings had Washington -2.5 on Oct 5 (SI Betting), Kalshi still -2.5 on Oct 9 (SportsBettingDime, Oct 9); slate number is -3, so Iowa gets the best number seen. Helps Iowa.
Iowa's defense ranks 7th in adjusted EPA/play and allows 12.6 ppg (T-8th FBS) (SI Betting Oct 5; Pickdawgz Oct 7 2026). Helps Iowa in a projected low-scoring game (total 41.5).
Washington's offense ranks 107th in EPA/pass, 124th on third/fourth-down success and 126th in rushing (109 ypg); it went 1-of-12 on third downs vs USC (SI Betting Oct 5; Pickdawgz Oct 7). Helps Iowa.

Iowa QB Hank Brown is questionable with a sprained AC joint from the Ohio State loss; he said 'there's definitely a little bit of question'; backup Jeremy Hecklinski is 56.3% for 208 yds in 3 appearances (Roundtable, Oct 7 2026). SI (Oct 5) called Brown likely to play. Helps Washington if Brown sits.
Iowa's offense is weak on the ground: 111th in EPA/rush, 101st in success rate, and held under 21 points in 3 of 5 games (SI Oct 5; Pickdawgz Oct 7). Helps Washington.
Iowa's defense ranks 92nd in EPA/pass allowed, and Washington WR Dezmen Roebuck has 35 catches (T-10th FBS) (SI Oct 5; Pickdawgz Oct 7). Helps Washington.

[angle] Washington's two losses were each by one possession (27-24 at Minnesota, 25-21 vs USC); it is still seeking its first Big Ten and first ranked win (Roundtable Oct 7; Pickdawgz Oct 7). Close-game team: helps the +3 side, Iowa.
[angle] Late Friday 9 PM ET kickoff in Seattle after Iowa's road trip to Ohio State the previous week; Iowa travels two time zones for a night game (SI Oct 5). Slight help to Washington.
[angle] Washington CB Jeron Jones is doubtful, but nickel Rahshawn Clark and CB Emmanuel Karnley returned from injury (Roundtable, Oct 7 2026). Neutral to slight help for Washington's pass defense.
Third-down edge: Iowa converts 40.3% vs Washington 29.0%; Washington is +5 in turnovers, Iowa +2 (SportsBettingDime, Oct 9 2026). Third downs help Iowa; turnovers help Washington.
Model and expert split: one model had Washington 50.4% to win; SI's Peter Dewey picked Iowa +2.5; Pickdawgz picked Washington -2.5 (Oct 5-9 2026). Near coin flip, which favors taking +3.
games.reasoning: A low total (41.5), Iowa's top-10 defense against a Washington offense that can't pass or convert third downs, and Washington's 1-4 ATS mark make a one-score Washington edge at most, so +3 is the side. The most interesting [angle] is Washington losing both Big Ten games by one possession: this projects as a field-goal game. A confirmed Brown absence would have pushed it to a pass. CONTAMINATED: I saw the result before locking (see note), so treat this as graded separately.
games.contaminationNote: While searching for Washington's injury report, a search summary stated that Washington's QB Demond Williams Jr. was hurt 'after the 41-24 loss' to Iowa, and result-page headlines ('Washington Huskies suffer another key injury in loss to No. 20 Iowa Hawkeyes') appeared. I saw this before deciding. My pre-game evidence (SI's pick, Washington 1-4 ATS, Iowa defense) already leaned Iowa, but the pick was locked after seeing the result.

research: BYU RB LJ Martin (2025 Big 12 Offensive Player of the Year, 344 yds in 4 games) was ruled out with a lower-body/ankle injury, expected to miss 4-6 weeks (KUTV/AP, Oct 8 2026; KSL, Oct 6 2026). Helps Iowa State.
All-Big 12 LB Isaiah Glasker was listed doubtful/out with a lower-body injury from the TCU game (KSL Oct 6; Covers Oct 9 2026). Weakens BYU's run defense vs a run-heavy ISU. Helps Iowa State.

Without Martin vs TCU, BYU managed 216 total yards, 3.5 yards per play and 17 points after averaging 44 ppg; Bachmeier went 11-of-24 for a career-low 62 yards (KUTV Oct 8; Covers Oct 9 2026). Helps Iowa State.

[spread] Line movement: TeamRankings tracked BYU opening -14.5 and falling to a low of -9.5 (slate number); SI had -10.5 on Oct 5. The market moved toward Iowa State on the injury news. Helps Iowa State.
[spread] BYU is 4-0 ATS this season (SI Betting Oct 5 2026); Iowa State is 2-2-1 ATS (search summary of pre-game previews). Helps BYU.

Iowa State RB Aiden Flora ran for 212 yards and 5 total TDs in the 45-42 win over West Virginia and was AP National Player of the Week; ISU has 100+ rushing yards in 22 straight games and 987 rushing yards through five games, its most since 2009 (KUTV/AP, Oct 8 2026). Helps Iowa State.
BYU's offense still ranks 3rd in EPA/rush and 1st in rush success rate on the season (SI Betting Oct 5 2026), though mostly with Martin. Helps BYU.
Iowa State's defense ranks 53rd in adjusted EPA/play and 95th in EPA/rush allowed (SI Betting Oct 5 2026). Helps BYU's committee run game (Rex, Tonga, Bachmeier).

[angle] Pace: Iowa State ranks 119th and BYU 134th in seconds per play; both run often (26th and 17th in rush rate) (Covers, Oct 9 2026). Fewer possessions make a double-digit cover harder. Helps Iowa State.

[angle] BYU is 0-3 all-time at home vs Iowa State, losing 45-13 in Provo in 2023 (KUTV/AP Oct 8 2026); first-year ISU coach Jimmy Rogers and new QB Jaylen Raynor mean last year's 41-27 BYU win says little. Small help to Iowa State.
[angle] Iowa State lost to Utah by 14 and to Iowa by 3, staying within two scores of both ranked opponents (SI Betting Oct 5 2026). Helps Iowa State +9.5.
Weather: low 70s, 7 mph wind, 8% rain (Covers, Oct 9 2026). Neutral.
games.reasoning: BYU's 4-0 ATS run came with LJ Martin; without him (and LB Glasker) the offense produced 216 yards vs TCU, and a slow, run-first game against Iowa State's strong ground attack projects as a one-score BYU win. The line already fell from 14.5 to 9.5, but I still make it about BYU by 6-7. The [angle] that decided it: both teams play slowly, which limits margins. A healthy Martin would have flipped me to a pass.
